design.data_dir_resolution: explicit dataDir > OMB_DATA_DIR > <home>/.openmausbot (§4.5); resolved dir + source are reported
design.layering: Full adapter layers on top of the frozen T003 PoC (openmausbot-poc.ts, NOT modified) + T005 discovery/manifest + T006 kernel (src/resolver). The S0 gate calls the PoC directly and is untouched.
design.missing_lists_rule: Every kind in requireLists (default assigned/imported/plugin) must appear in the snapshot or be declared empty in emptyLists; otherwise INCOMPLETE for that scope. Absence is never read as empty.
modules: src/adapters/openmausbot/adapter.ts — auditOpenMausBot: data-dir resolution, snapshot acquisition, completeness checks, kernel wiring
src/adapters/openmausbot/snapshot.ts — versioned snapshot contract validation + file loading (no new runtime dependency)
src/adapters/openmausbot/index.ts — public barrel (adapter + snapshot + PoC re-exports)
design.plugin_disable_path_adr008: disabledPluginIds switches a plugin skill to DISABLED (proven end-to-end through the kernel, a08). A plugin skill with no pluginId has no per-plugin disable path: marked UNKNOWN + SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED for PLUGIN (INCOMPLETE).
design.policy: Owned by the T006 kernel (ADR-005/ADR-006 unchanged): policy passed through, effective set = ELIGIBLE only; DISCOVERED never leaks; UNKNOWN never leaks (fails closed as INCOMPLETE).
design.snapshot_rule_adr007: A missing, unreadable or malformed snapshot is INCOMPLETE (SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED, unknownScopes [SNAPSHOT]) — the PoC's empty-inventory default does NOT carry over to the full adapter. Unknown version still flows to the PoC version gate.

known_limitations: The adapter does not parse any undocumented OpenMausBot storage (no SQLite schema guessing, no private API) — a bot whose inventory lives only in undocumented storage is reported INCOMPLETE via the snapshot requirement, not silently covered.
Snapshot-vs-disk reconciliation only covers scanRoots the caller declares; a skill root nobody declares is not scanned (same boundary as the PoC's loadableRoots).
The full-manifest re-check re-reads each snapshot skill's SKILL.md once (one extra read per skill); it does not change the PoC's minimal-parser verdict for skills the PoC already flagged.
DUPLICATE_CONTENT / SAME_NAME_COLLISION findings still come from the PoC only; the adapter adds no new cross-instance content analysis.
The adapter has no CLI entry yet — T009 wires auditOpenMausBot into the CLI and must load the profile policy and pass it through (ADR-005), or policy findings will be silently absent.
